description: This PHP class defines a Drupal form for the upgrade overview process in the migrate_drupal_ui module, including form building, submission handling, and redirect logic.

classes.name: OverviewForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for displaying the upgrade overview and handling the upgrade process.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.
